name: cloud-build-basics
description: >- Teaches the fundamentals of Google Cloud Build (GCB). Covers core concepts, API enablement, console navigation to the Build History page, and the end-to-end workflow for creating and manually running a basic build trigger. Do not use for managing private pools or complex pipeline architectures.
author: google
summary_zh: 一份 Google Cloud Build 入门教程，适合学习基础概念、启用 API，并创建和手动运行简单的构建触发器。
